مُدَالِكٌ Any one who delays, defers, or puts off, by repeated promises. (TA.) ―
-b2- One who does not hold himself above a low, or an ignoble, action. (Fr, TA.) IF says, in the “ Makáyees, ” [but the remark does not universally hold good,] that every word commencing with د and ل denotes motion, coming and going, and removal from place to place. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
